test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The state of Telangana has been carved out of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• On **June 2, 2014**, Telangana became a **state** in its official capacity.
 
• The** Congress Working Committee** overwhelmingly approved a resolution on the creation of a separate Telangana state on **July 1, 2013.**
 
• The Bill was introduced to Parliament in **February 2014 **after going through several phases.
 
• In February 2014, **Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act**, 2014 Bill was passed by the Parliament for the formation of Telangana State.
 
• On **March 1, 2014**, the measure was approved by the** President** and published in the gazette.
 
• **KCR, Kalvakuntla Chandrashekar Rao** was chosen to serve as Telangana's first **chief minister.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Telangana

 
• **Governor**: Sri Jishnu Dev Varma
 
• **Chief minister: **Sri Anumula Revanth Reddy

 
• **Capital:** Hyderabad
